\section[(dialogue)]{The body, family and doing — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R60-first-pass-the-body-family-and-doing}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to pay and to use.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an arm, a leg, a foot, a finger, a tooth
  \item the tongue; a language, the neck, a shoulder, the back, hair
  \item the belly, the face, blood, skin, a nail
  \item the chin, the forehead, pain, a fever, a cough
  \item medicine, a doctor, a hospital, an illness, hunger
  \item thirst, tiredness, tired, ill, joy
  \item fear, anger, sadness, happy, sad
  \item a son, a daughter, a grandfather, a grandmother, a husband
  \item a wife, an aunt, a cousin, a cousin, a little boy
  \item a little girl, a neighbour, a guest; a host, a boy, a girl
  \item to sing, to dance, to laugh, to cry, to wash
  \item to cook, to sell, to swim, to call, to sleep
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An arm? (\textbf{il braccio}.) A leg? (\textbf{la gamba}.) A foot? (\textbf{il piede}.) A finger? (\textbf{il dito}.) A tooth? (\textbf{il dente}.) The tongue; a language? (\textbf{la lingua}.) The neck? (\textbf{il collo}.) A shoulder? (\textbf{la spalla}.) The back? (\textbf{la schiena}.) Hair? (\textbf{i capelli}.) The belly? (\textbf{la pancia}.) The face? (\textbf{il viso}.) Blood? (\textbf{il sangue}.) Skin? (\textbf{la pelle}.) A nail? (\textbf{l'unghia}.) The chin? (\textbf{il mento}.) The forehead? (\textbf{la fronte}.) Pain? (\textbf{il dolore}.) A fever? (\textbf{la febbre}.) A cough? (\textbf{la tosse}.) Medicine? (\textbf{la medicina}.) A doctor? (\textbf{il medico}.) A hospital? (\textbf{l'ospedale}.) An illness? (\textbf{la malattia}.) Hunger? (\textbf{la fame}.) Thirst? (\textbf{la sete}.) Tiredness? (\textbf{la stanchezza}.) Tired? (\textbf{stanco}.) Ill? (\textbf{malato}.) Joy? (\textbf{la gioia}.) Fear? (\textbf{la paura}.) Anger? (\textbf{la rabbia}.) Sadness? (\textbf{la tristezza}.) Happy? (\textbf{felice}.) Sad? (\textbf{triste}.) A son? (\textbf{il figlio}.) A daughter? (\textbf{la figlia}.) A grandfather? (\textbf{il nonno}.) A grandmother? (\textbf{la nonna}.) A husband? (\textbf{il marito}.) A wife? (\textbf{la moglie}.) An aunt? (\textbf{la zia}.) A cousin? (\textbf{il cugino}.) A cousin? (\textbf{la cugina}.) A little boy? (\textbf{il bambino}.) A little girl? (\textbf{la bambina}.) A neighbour? (\textbf{il vicino}.) A guest; a host? (\textbf{l'ospite}.) A boy? (\textbf{il ragazzo}.) A girl? (\textbf{la ragazza}.) To sing? (\textbf{cantare}.) To dance? (\textbf{ballare}.) To laugh? (\textbf{ridere}.) To cry? (\textbf{piangere}.) To wash? (\textbf{lavare}.) To cook? (\textbf{cucinare}.) To sell? (\textbf{vendere}.) To swim? (\textbf{nuotare}.) To call? (\textbf{chiamare}.) To sleep? (\textbf{dormire}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
